mcqs.question: What does the review call the methacholine challenge?

options.A: The most common direct bronchoprovocation test
options.D: A test that cannot be standardised

mcqs.correctAnswerText: The most common direct bronchoprovocation test
mcqs.explanation: Methacholine challenge is described as the most common direct bronchoprovocation test.

sourceRefs.excerpt: the most common direct bronchoprovocation test

mcqs.question: How long can long-acting anti-muscarinic bronchoprotection last, according to the review?
mcqs.explanation: Specific antimuscarinic agents show marked bronchoprotection, up to 7 days for the long-acting drugs, lasting longer than bronchodilation.

sourceRefs.excerpt: up to 7 days for the long-acting drugs

mcqs.question: What does a single dose of ICS or a leukotriene-receptor antagonist do to the methacholine test?

options.B: It abolishes the test for a week
options.C: It is required before every test
options.D: It doubles PC20 in every patient
options.E: It is dangerous and forbidden on the test day only because of anaphylaxis

mcqs.explanation: Single doses of those controllers have no effect, whereas regular ICS use does.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Single doses of controller medications, such as inhaled corticosteroids (ICS) and leukotriene receptor antagonists, have no effect on the methacholine test

mcqs.question: What does the review say about tolerance to beta-2 agonist bronchoprotection?

options.A: Tolerance develops quickly, especially to long-acting agents

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Tolerance develops quickly, especially to long-acting agents
mcqs.explanation: Tolerance develops quickly, especially to the long-acting agents.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Tolerance develops quickly, especially to the long-acting agents.

mcqs.question: Why does the review discuss washout before methacholine challenge?

options.A: Because drugs that affect the response must be withheld for an appropriate period as part of standardisation
options.D: Patients should take all inhalers immediately before the test

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Because drugs that affect the response must be withheld for an appropriate period as part of standardisation
mcqs.explanation: One aspect of standardisation is the appropriate washout of drugs that affect the response.

sourceRefs.excerpt: appropriate washout period for pharmacologic agents which affect the response
